statement: Saraswati Yoga (Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury together placed in kendra, trikona, or 2nd houses, with Jupiter well-dignified) is traditionally read as carrying exceptional learning, eloquence, and artistic or intellectual accomplishment — named for Saraswati, goddess of knowledge and the arts.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
